endpoints.description: Create a new user account with email and password and return a JWT token and user profile.
endpoints.responseType: { token: string; user: { id: string; email: string; role: string } }

endpoints.description: Authenticate an existing user (customer or staff) with email and password and return a JWT token and user profile.
endpoints.responseType: { token: string; user: { id: string; email: string; role: string } }

endpoints.description: List all menu items (drinks and pastries) with prices, categories, and availability status.
Add a new drink or pastry item to the menu catalog (staff only).
endpoints.requestType: { name: string; description?: string; price: number; is_available: boolean; category: string }

endpoints.description: Update an existing menu item's details, price, or availability / out-of-stock status (staff only).
endpoints.requestType: { name?: string; description?: string; price?: number; is_available?: boolean; category?: string }

endpoints.description: Place a new pre-order with selected available menu items, quantities, optional notes, and pickup time (authenticated customer only; paid in-store at pickup).
endpoints.requestType: { pickup_time: string; items: { menu_item_id: string; quantity: number; notes?: string }[] }

endpoints.description: List the currently authenticated customer's active and past pre-orders with itemized details.
List all incoming and active customer pre-orders with customer email and itemized line items for the barista dashboard (staff only).
Update the status of a pre-order, e.g. pending, preparing, ready, completed, or cancelled (staff only).
